output.summary: An annual grass native to Europe and introduced across most continents, often as a troublesome crop weed. Its flower-head bristles have backward-pointing barbs that hook onto clothing or animal fur. Its seeds are used for beer in South Africa and porridge in Namibia, and have served as famine food in India.
output.edibilityNote: Seeds are used for beer in South Africa, porridge in Namibia and historically as famine food in India.
